text:
The son will most likely **lose**. Although he is an intended third-party beneficiary, his rights had not vested when the landscaper and owner agreed to redirect payment to the father, since he had not relied on the contract, assented to it, or sued. Because the parties could still modify or discharge the contract before vesting, the owner's payment to the father discharged the owner's duty, though a consideration challenge to the modification is the main risk.

CONFIDENCE: 70
